issue.body:
﻿## Verified player capability gap

A player can rotate/mirror complete Room plans, but cannot rotate a separately placed individual object. This is visible in the genuine Classroom teacher-desk integration route: both q0 and q1 Classroom plans have legal free 2×1 slots, but a separately bought desk can only be placed in orientation0. A vertical 1×2 slot or choosing the teacher-facing side is not publicly expressible.

### Current source evidence

Verified at [fa49f78412441fb50a3cce839e56f241a8b63462](https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/commit/fa49f78412441fb50a3cce839e56f241a8b63462):

- [Strict PlaceObject protocol](https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/blob/fa49f78412441fb50a3cce839e56f241a8b63462/src/simulation/protocol/commands.ts#L426): explicitly documents no orientation; schema at line449 contains type/orderId/definitionId/x/y only and rejects orientation1.
- [Public UI command producer](https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/blob/fa49f78412441fb50a3cce839e56f241a8b63462/src/main.ts#L3463): the real place-object UI intent submits that unrotated command.
- [Placement service](https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/blob/fa49f78412441fb50a3cce839e56f241a8b63462/src/simulation/objects/object-placement-service.ts#L459): ordinary placement defaults to0, while authored room templates can supply their orientation internally.
- [Actual typed public route](https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/blob/fa49f78412441fb50a3cce839e56f241a8b63462/tests/integration/native-classroom-desk-preparation.test.ts): unchanged original Classroom templates, a separate two-plank/130 purchase, exact non-template desk owners, orientation0 in both room rotations, and whole V8 roundtrip. No injected snapshots, private fixture placement or browser result claimed.

### Player impact and requested behavior

Individual furniture cannot be aligned to the room, doorway, aisle or remaining vertical footprint even though rotated authored templates and retained angled art already exist. Expose a deliberate public individual-object rotation control with accessible keyboard/pointer behavior, a correctly rotated whole-footprint preview/collision check, and consistent placement, cost and owner semantics.

Acceptance must use actual public built-client placement for q0/q1 individual desks (2×1 versus1×2), collision/ownership refusal, native camera inspection and whole paused Save/Load. Preserve the existing original templates and costs. Decide the input/command contract as a separate change; this issue does not authorize a protocol or save-format workaround in the Classroom art/native preparation branch.

### Fresh duplicate check

Searched open and closed issues for individual object rotation, rotate furniture, PlaceObject orientation, rotation/rotate in titles, orientation+object, and individual+rotat. Read #1586: it covers complete room-plan rotation, not individual-object rotation. No matching individual-object control issue was found. Camera rotation and native room-plan popup issues are separate surfaces.
issue.title: Individual furniture placement has no public rotation control
